enhance_arrow_1.name: Enhance Arrow +1
enhance_arrow_1.description: Every nonmagical arrow nocked gains a +1 enhancement bonus (+2 at 3rd, +3 at 5th, +4 at 7th, +5 at 9th).

imbue_arrow.name: Imbue Arrow
imbue_arrow.description: Place an area spell upon an arrow so that the spell's area is centered on where the arrow lands.

seeker_arrow.name: Seeker Arrow
seeker_arrow.description: Launch an arrow 1/day that travels to a known target, negating cover and concealment modifiers.

phase_arrow.name: Phase Arrow
phase_arrow.description: Launch an arrow 1/day that travels in a straight path, passing through nonmagical barriers/walls (negates cover, concealment, and armor/shield).

hail_of_arrows.name: Hail of Arrows
hail_of_arrows.description: In lieu of regular attacks, fire an arrow at each and every target within range 1/day (up to 1 target per arcane archer level).

arrow_of_death.name: Arrow of Death
arrow_of_death.description: Create an arrow of death that forces the target, if damaged by the arrow, to make a DC 20 Fortitude save or be slain immediately.
